purpose: First-data nominal-Y / horizontal QR image slope, per uninterrupted timestamp-defined run and per QR

method.input_measurements: Saved per-QR ROI-center horizontal displacement from center.bmp using ZNCC initialization and affine ECC
method.reanchoring: Within each run: q_i = label_i - label_first; u_i = saved_dx_i - saved_dx_first
method.regression: u_i = a*q_i + c + residual_i; unweighted least squares with freely fitted c; not forced through the first sample
method.qr_mean: Arithmetic mean of the three QR displacement measurements; per-QR results retained
method.sign: Positive image x is right; signed filename-Y differences retained; no physical axis direction inferred
method.theta_condition: Nominally fixed theta during each Y-only acquisition run; no independent pose verification
method.time_role: Group and order only; original filesystem mtime is not a verified exposure timestamp

limitations: No new raw-image registration: this analysis reuses existing measured positions and their biases.
Adjacent changes are differences of center-referenced positions, not fresh direct pair registrations.
Slopes refer to nominal filename millimetres, not independently measured true stage displacement.
No common zero or pooled cross-run straight line is imposed. The descriptive slope mean is not a calibrated universal conversion.
Adjacent pairs share images; their spread is descriptive, not independent repeated-motion precision or a confidence interval.
RMS is an in-sample linear-fit residual, not physical positioning error or proof of meeting the alignment tolerances.
Results concern the observed theta condition only; no theta-dependent model, theta slope, or mixed-axis decomposition was fitted.
